—1 Possession, property.
—2 Work, sacrificial act or rite,

अप्नः + -स्थ a. superintending work (कर्मण्यधिकृत); (or m.)
 proprietor of an estate.

अप्नः + -राजः lord of wealth or property, illustrious by means of works;
 directing works to be done (कर्मप्रेरक).

अप्नवान + .{@-नः@} [अप्नसे आदायकर्मणे वानं यस्य पृषो˚ सलोप Tv.]
—1 The arm.
—2 N. of a Ṛṣi in the family of or connected with Bhṛgu. यमप्नवानो
 भृगवो विरुरुचुः Rv. 4. 7. 1.
अप्नस्वत् a. Having (sacrificial) acts or works; productive.
